messages:
sajid: Hey team, customer hit a 422 when using function/tool calling with our schema. They included request_id=req_6b2f9a4c and say the payload validates on their side. Need repro steps + logs to escalate.

tara: thanks — can you paste the exact curl you used (headers + body) and the full 422 response body? also which model/version and whether this was on Hosted vs Dedicated? :eyes:

sajid: posting curl + server side error snippet below. Hosted, model=redwood-v1.3.1, time ~2025-07-18T14:02:04Z. req id again: req_6b2f9a4c

sajid: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1.3.1","input":"call_tool","tool_call":{"name":"invoice_extractor","arguments":{"invoice_text":"..."}}}'
```

sajid: 422 response (trimmed): ```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "tool_schema_validation",
    "message": "Missing required property: billing_id",
    "request_id": "req_6b2f9a4c",
    "schema_path": "/tool_call/arguments"
  }
}```

devin: hmmm — two quick possibilities: client-side used a different schema (maybe 'billingId' vs 'billing_id'), or our schema validation layer is stricter for function calls. Can you confirm the exact JSON you sent in the tool_call.arguments field? also include Content-Length and whether any proxy is mutating payload.

sajid: full tool_call.arguments we sent: ```json
{"invoice_text":"...","billingId":"acct-1234"}
```

tara: ok that explains it — billingId vs billing_id mismatch. But customer insists they send billing_id. @devin can we check if our incoming JSON key normalization (snake/camel handling) changed in the last deploy? maybe a regression in the fncall validation layer.

devin: I'll grep deploy history. quick log extract for req_6b2f9a4c from proxy-ingress: ```
[2025-07-18T14:02:03Z] req=req_6b2f9a4c POST /v1/invoke content-length=342 ip=1.2.3.4
[2025-07-18T14:02:03Z] payload={..."billing_id":null,"billingId":"acct-1234"} 
[2025-07-18T14:02:03Z] routed->serving-11
[2025-07-18T14:02:04Z] validation_error: Missing required property: billing_id
```

alex: note: if both billing_id and billingId are present our validation currently prefers billing_id and will error if it's null. Looks like ingress might be normalizing/mapping keys and introducing null. We should collect: raw request body, ingress logs, serving runtime logs, and a debug bundle. Also collect the customer's curl + exact payload.

ops-bot: automated check: no recent schema changes to function invoice_extractor in last 90d. deployment 2025-07-18 12:47:09 shows ingress sidecar v2.14.3 rolled at 2025-07-18T12:46:50.

tara: plan of action: 1) sajid, ask customer to run a minimal curl that includes --data-binary and not any client library that might mutate keys; example below. 2) sajid upload raw request body or paste it. 3) devin will pull ingress sidecar logs for the time window and check key-mapping middleware. 4) if repro, generate debug bundle (instructions below) and include request_id.

tara: sample curl to ask customer to run (please paste exact output back):```bash
curl -v -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  --data-binary '{"model":"redwood-v1.3.1","tool_call":{"name":"invoice_extractor","arguments":{"invoice_text":"<snippet>","billing_id":"acct-1234"}}}'
```

sajid: will send to customer now. also they reported a 800ms tail latency spike around the same time — could be related when the ingress tried to coerce fields. req_6b2f9a4c has timing entries in tracer: ingress 30ms, validator 5ms, serving runtime 750ms, validation error returned.

devin: thanks — when we collect the debug bundle include: ingress sidecar logs (5 minutes around timestamp), full request body saved from load-balancer, validator logs, and runtime container stdout/stderr. If possible export /metrics snapshot and our schema file for invoice_extractor. Use the internal debug endpoint: POST /debug/bundle?req=req_6b2f9a4c (ops has perms).

alex: adding: if customer can't reproduce with raw curl, ask for their SDK version and show them how to capture outgoing request (tcpdump or use --trace-ascii in curl). Also keep billing/contact info out of public logs — redact keys but keep request_id.

sajid: copy — I'll get the curl output and ask them to run. I'll follow up with the debug bundle once we have ingress logs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
